news_items.headline: Union Pacific files amended Norfolk Southern merger application; projects $3.5B annual shipper savings
news_items.summary: UNP and Norfolk Southern filed an amended merger application with the STB on April 30, 2026 projecting $3.5B in annual shipper savings if approved. UNP stated it will exit the deal if STB orders widespread line sales or trackage rights.

news_items.headline: Union Pacific rallies to 52-week high after Q1 earnings beat
news_items.summary: Shares rallied to a 52-week high following Q1: net income $1.70B / EPS $2.87 on revenue $6.22B; freight car velocity +9% to 235 daily miles per car; terminal dwell -11% to 19.7 hours.

news_items.headline: Union Pacific earnings call highlights record Q1 operational strength
news_items.summary: Q1 net income $1.7B (+5% YoY); EPS $2.87 (+6%). Both operating income and net income set first-quarter records. Management reiterated 2026 mid-single-digit reported EPS growth and further operating-ratio gains.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: no analyst-rating changes in last 7 days. Standing consensus across 22-36 covering analysts is Buy: ~17-18 Buy / 8-9 Hold / 1 Sell. Avg 12-month PT $272.33 (range $218-$311); some sources cite $275.55 average / $264.50 median; implied upside ~+8%.

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 was a record beat (net income $1.70B, EPS $2.87, revenue $6.22B). Street expects mid-single-digit reported EPS growth in 2026 driven by operational gains. Norfolk Southern $85B merger (expected close H1 2027) is the dominant medium-term catalyst; STB review ongoing with competition-impact scrutiny.
